info.title: posterProjects Mobile API
info.description: Stateless bearer-token surface at /api/v1, consumed by the posterMobile Flutter client. Tokens are Laravel Sanctum personal access tokens named `mobile` with the `mobile` ability, separate from the web session app and the `/mcp` bearer surface (which uses the `mcp` ability). This document describes the surface as implemented, including the exact JSON error contract. Version 2.0.0 is the Marcos OS cutover: the projects, issues, board-columns, sprints and labels operations were removed (their routes are unregistered and answer the generic 404) and replaced by `Objectives` and `Items`; the path prefix stays `/api/v1`.

servers.description: Relative to the application origin. Paths below already include the full /api/v1 prefix.

tags.name: Auth

tags.name: Objectives
tags.description: The owner's objectives (Marcos OS): keyed, single owner, with the Control 5-point plan and their tree of plans and items.

tags.name: Items
tags.description: Tasks and milestones of an objective, addressed by their public key (e.g. `SALUD-7`). State is derived: locked, available, active, done.

tags.name: Habits
tags.description: Today's habit list and the one-tap increment/decrement pair, anchored to the UTC-6 habit day. Creating, editing and archiving habits are web-only and are not exposed here.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a mobile bearer token
post.description: Validates the owner's email and password without starting a web session (Auth::validate(), never Auth::attempt()). On success, revokes every prior token named `mobile` before minting a new one named `mobile` with exactly the `mobile` ability. A pre-existing `mcp` token is never touched. Throttled by the named limiter `api-login`: 5 attempts per minute keyed by `email|ip`, and 10 attempts per minute keyed by `ip` alone; both successful and failed attempts count toward each limit.

200.description: Credentials valid. Returns the plain-text token; it is never shown again.

422.description: Missing/invalid fields, or a recognized-but-wrong email/password pair. Bad credentials are reported under the `email` field, reusing the existing Spanish copy.

value.message: Estas credenciales no coinciden con nuestros registros.

email: Estas credenciales no coinciden con nuestros registros.

429.description: 6th attempt within the one-minute window for the same email+IP, or 11th for the same IP.

example.message: Demasiados intentos de acceso. Por favor, inténtalo de nuevo en 42 segundos.

post.summary: Redeem a QR login pass for a mobile bearer token
post.description: Exchanges a short-lived, single-use QR pass (minted by an authenticated browser session at POST settings/mobile-token/qr) for a token byte-identical to POST /api/v1/login's: named `mobile`, ability `['mobile']`. Revokes every prior token named `mobile` before minting the new one; a pre-existing `mcp` token is never touched. Unauthenticated by design — the pass itself is the credential. Consumption is a single conditional UPDATE keyed on `affected === 1`; unknown, expired, already-consumed, and malformed pass values are indistinguishable and all produce the same 422 body (see the api-qr-login spec's 'Uniform Redemption Failure' requirement). Throttled by the named limiter `api-qr-redeem`: 10 attempts per minute keyed by IP alone, since no identity exists before a pass is validated.

200.description: Pass valid, unconsumed, and unexpired. Returns the plain-text token; it is never shown again.

422.description: The pass value is unknown, expired, already consumed, or malformed. All four causes are byte-identical and never disclose which one occurred.

example.message: El código QR no es válido o expiró.

token: El código QR no es válido o expiró.

429.description: 11th redemption attempt from the same IP within one minute.

example.message: Demasiados intentos de acceso. Por favor, inténtalo de nuevo en 42 segundos.

post.description: Marks an available or active item `done` through the same domain action as the web and answers the item detail plus `unlocked` (the items that became available). A locked item is `422`; a milestone needs a non-empty `evidence` (`422` otherwise); an already-done item is `200` unchanged (idempotent). Items of a closed objective are read-only (`422`). Requires the `mobile` ability.

post.description: The phone never sends an amount — every tap adds exactly 1 to the current UTC-6 day's accumulated_amount, recalculates completion_percent and the sticky completed flag, and returns the same shape as a GET /habits/today element (shape-identical by construction, design D-4). Not idempotent: repeating the request repeats the effect. Requires the `mobile` ability. Unknown, another user's, or archived `{habit}` all resolve to the identical generic 404.

bearerAuth.description: Plain-text Sanctum token minted by POST /api/v1/login, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Carries the `mobile` ability (or the legacy wildcard `['*']`).

token.description: Plain-text Sanctum token. Shown once; not recoverable afterward.
Plaintext QR pass payload, minted once by POST settings/mobile-token/qr and shown only in that response.

QrLoginFailureResponse.description: The single uniform failure body for POST /api/v1/qr-login. Unknown, expired, already-consumed, and malformed pass values are indistinguishable and all produce this exact body.

TodayHabit.description: Exactly these 12 fields. The four day-derived fields (accumulated_amount, completion_percent, completed, peak_amount) are flattened to their zero/false value when nothing has been logged today — never null. peak_amount is the day's high-water mark and is load-bearing: it is the only field on the wire that explains a completed day whose accumulated_amount was corrected downward by a decrement.

date.description: The UTC-6 day this row belongs to, per element.

target.description: Server-computed: max(1, daily_target) for quantitative habits, 1 for yes/no.

completed.description: Sticky once true: never recomputed from accumulated_amount alone.

peak_amount.description: The day's high-water mark. Never drops, even when a decrement corrects accumulated_amount downward.

week_recorded_days.description: Days already recorded in the current Monday-based week. Populated only for times_per_week habits; null otherwise.

errors.description: Field name to array of error messages.

message.example: Este token no tiene permiso para usar esta API.

message.description: Spanish throttle message including the retry delay in seconds.

Objective.description: Pinned objective shape: exactly these 10 fields. `progress` counts the non-retired items and comes from eager aggregates.

prerequisite_keys.description: Keys of the non-retired prerequisites, possibly from other objectives.

ItemDetail.description: Pinned item detail: exactly these 14 fields.

target_date.description: Optional; a past date never changes the state.

unlocked.description: Items that became available because of this check (empty when the item was already done).

evidence.description: Required and non-empty for a milestone; ignored for a task.
